name: romantic-rose-balloon-girl
image_purpose: show a refined Valentine lifestyle portrait with roses and balloons

prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with long waist-length black hair and soft confident smile, wearing a cream satin slip dress with thin straps and an elegant open back. Keep the fit flattering and non-sexualized.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical eye-level medium full-body framing cropped above the knees, three-quarter back pose, subject slightly right of center, metallic red heart balloons at varied heights, curling ribbons, and dense red-white roses on the floor in a residential interior.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused warm indoor light, gentle shadows, crisp balloon specular highlights, high-contrast ivory-red-white palette.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 50-85mm portrait-lens aesthetic, f/2.8-f/4 depth of field, crisp detail, low noise, natural skin retouching.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic romantic Valentine indoor lifestyle portrait of one generic approved adult woman with long black hair and a soft confident smile, cream satin slip dress with thin straps and elegant open back, three-quarter back pose, red heart balloons with curling ribbons, dense red-white roses on the floor, warm residential interior, soft diffused light, realistic satin and balloon reflections, refined influencer photography, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, transparent clothing, sexualized posing, fetish styling, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed
